title: 4-bit comparator

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)

pins.name: A<Bin
pins.text: cascade input from a less significant stage

pins.name: A=Bin
pins.text: cascade input; tie high on the least significant stage

pins.name: A>Bin
pins.text: cascade input from a less significant stage

functions.formula: A>Bout = (A > B) OR ((A = B) AND A=Bin' AND A<Bin')
functions.text: High when the word A3..A0 is greater than B3..B0. When the words are equal it is high when the A=B and A<B cascade inputs are both low (so A>Bin=H gives H, and all three cascade inputs low gives H as well, per the '85 function table).

functions.formula: A<Bout = (A < B) OR ((A = B) AND A=Bin' AND A>Bin')
functions.text: High when A3..A0 is less than B3..B0. When the words are equal it is high when the A=B and A>B cascade inputs are both low.
High only when the words are equal and the A=B cascade input is high.
